blocks.text: Magic MariaI booked a 90 min massage Maria looked after every part of my body with love and tenderness clearly toping my vacation and the 2018 year the best way possible They were very considerate of my allergies and used a cream I bought from home and although it was very strong they took my wishes into consideration and gave me the best massage with the best hands I’ve felt ever which put me to sleep on two separate occasions I’ll be coming back to Noosa soon hopefully for another vacation and I’ll be wanting Maria back with her hands and magic touch I loved it Truly amazingRoberto G. | Noosa, QLD
blocks.html:
Magic Maria

I booked a 90 min massage 


Maria looked after every part of my body with love and tenderness clearly toping my vacation and the 2018 year the best way possible 


They were very considerate of my allergies and used a cream I bought from home and although it was very strong they took my wishes into consideration and gave me the best massage with the best hands I’ve felt ever which put me to sleep on two separate occasions 


I’ll be coming back to Noosa soon hopefully for another vacation and I’ll be wanting Maria back with her hands and magic touch 


I loved it 

Truly amazing


Roberto G. | Noosa, QLD

blocks.text: My friends and I went for on a girls weekend away. I had a 45min facial which was my first ever one. I found it very relaxing and soothing. My therapist was Maria who was very friendly. The neck and head massage was amazing.Nicky | Noosa, QLD
